This addendum corrects the admitted-member scope in the frozen BRIEF.md (SHA256 86d66542bfcac53d74499bf8808edc2855406b026610452d9f42363615a668e6). That brief and SOURCE-INPUTS.json (a397a5c167a63bfcec1ce1f577a42f3225e2e4ea3da6b42e5e792c6ca3ec6dc4) remain unchanged.

The fixed resolver's MODEL_SPECS selects four files for tiny, base, small and medium, including vocabulary.txt. It selects five files for large and large-v3-turbo, including preprocessor_config.json and vocabulary.json. Bind the admitted envelope, physical read set, readback and child-local lease to the exact selected model's membership, names, sizes and digests.

For the admitted route, replace the opening instruction "five selected, verified buffers" with "the selected model's four or five verified buffers." In change 3, replace "complete five-member names/sizes/digests" with "the selected model's complete four- or five-member names/sizes/digests." These are the frozen brief's two fixed-five membership requirements; this addendum supersedes both. The existing generated five-member route remains unchanged.

Add a seventeenth proposed control: successful admitted four-file namespace issuance for a selected tiny/base/small/medium record containing vocabulary.txt, through the actual new controller-to-child sequence and inert lower services. It must verify exact membership and retained buffers, including the absence of preprocessor_config.json. Keep the existing success control for a selected five-file record.

Do not fabricate a preprocessor file or translate vocabulary.txt into vocabulary.json. Namespace issuance does not authorize a constructor or its filesystem fallback. Constructor eligibility, options and fallback refusal remain a separate unit.

SUPPLEMENTAL-SOURCE.json binds the direct resolver identified by root's read 3dfe02. This correction uses that reported source finding; no new source inspection, code change or execution occurred.
